Sure! To fetch node details you’ll typically hit an endpoint such as `/api/nodes` on your server.  
If you’re working against our Insight‑Groups API, you can do it via the helper below:

```python
from functions import requests_get

response = requests_get(
    url="https://your-api-host.com/api/nodes",
    params={
        # Optional filters – adjust according to your needs:
        "query": "status=active",   # e.g., only active nodes
        "limit": 20,                # max items per page
        "sort": "asc"
    }
)
print(response)      # JSON payload containing node list & metadata
```

**What’s happening here**

| Argument | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `url` | Full HTTPS address pointing at the “nodes” resource. |
| `params.query` | Search/filter expression (if supported). |
| `params.limit` | Pagination size. |
| `params.sort` | Order (`asc` / `desc`). |
